title: New pending state has a success exit only: a failed async payment leaves the row pending and the vacancy locked forever
evidence:
+      wisp.log_info(
+        "Stripe event "
+        <> event_id
+        <> " ("
+        <> arm
+        <> ") payment_status='"
+        <> payment_status
+        <> "' not 'paid' — vacancy stays locked, payment row stays pending; will settle via checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded",
---
+/// M-1 rationale (security audit fix-now): without the restriction Stripe
+/// shows every payment method enabled on the account (SEPA direct debit,
+/// Boleto, Klarna), and async methods fire `checkout.session.completed`
+/// with `payment_status: "processing"`/`"unpaid"` — funds settle later or
+/// fail entirely (SEPA chargebacks). Card-only makes `completed` ⇒ `paid`
+/// for every session we create.
detail: Only async_payment_succeeded is wired as the settle exit; the diff acknowledges funds "fail entirely (SEPA chargebacks)" but adds no checkout.session.async_payment_failed arm. A failed async payment (SEPA return, Boleto expiry) leaves the row pending and the vacancy locked forever, reachable for pre-deploy in-flight sessions the idempotency-tag bump acknowledges exist.
recommended_fix: Handle checkout.session.async_payment_failed: mark the payment row failed, notify the landlord, and add a cleanup/terminal path for parked pending rows.

title: Gate permanently parks payment_status "no_payment_required": a $0 total (100% promo) never unlocks and no settle event ever arrives
evidence:
+          case payment_status {
+            "paid" ->
+              run_completed_side_effects(
+                tx,
+                config,
+                event_id,
+                session_id,
+                payment_intent,
+                amount_cents,
+                amount_total_opt,
+                consent_terms,
+                vacancy_id_opt,
+                sku_type_metadata_opt,
+              )
+            _ -> Ok(PendingPayment)
+          }
---
     #("allow_promotion_codes", "true"),
detail: A $0 checkout (100% promo; allow_promotion_codes=true is preserved in the refactored body) completes with payment_status "no_payment_required", which the gate treats as pending. Nothing settles, so the vacancy stays locked permanently, acked 200 and claimed with no alert.
recommended_fix: Treat "no_payment_required" as a valid completed state for $0 totals, or drop promotion-code support, so zero-total sessions unlock instead of parking forever.

title: New claim arm depends on an unverified schema assumption the field notes themselves flag
detail: The claim insert now stores "checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded" in processed_stripe_event.event_type. If that column is constrained, the claim insert fails, the whole tx rolls back, and Stripe retries indefinitely. The diff merges without resolving its own "verify before assuming".
recommended_fix: Verify processed_stripe_event.event_type is unconstrained before merging; if it is constrained, add a migration or map the arm to an existing value.

title: Structurally missing payment_status is silently consumed: acked 200, claimed, logged at info only
evidence:
+    // M-1 gate input: `checkout.session.payment_status`. Stripe always
+    // sends it on Session events, but `optionally_at` keeps a structurally
+    // missing field from failing the whole decode — an absent value
+    // decodes to None and the gate treats anything != "paid" as pending
+    // (fail-closed; see handle_checkout_completed).
detail: A malformed event (missing payment_status) is parked and permanently claimed with an info-level log: no warning, no Sentry event, no Stripe retry. A Stripe payload-shape change would silently strand every paid landlord with no recovery path.
recommended_fix: Log pending-gate trips at warning level and fire a Sentry alert when payment_status is missing (vs. a known pending value like "unpaid"), so ops notices stranded sessions.

title: "processing" is not a valid Checkout Session payment_status — the test pins an input Stripe never sends
evidence:
+/// M-1 rationale (security audit fix-now): without the restriction Stripe
+/// shows every payment method enabled on the account (SEPA direct debit,
+/// Boleto, Klarna), and async methods fire `checkout.session.completed`
+/// with `payment_status: "processing"`/`"unpaid"` — funds settle later or
+/// fail entirely (SEPA chargebacks).
---
+pub fn checkout_completed_processing_keeps_vacancy_locked_test() {
detail: Session-level payment_status is paid/unpaid/no_payment_required; "processing" exists only on PaymentIntent, and delayed methods complete with "unpaid". The processing test exercises an impossible input, giving false confidence; the unpaid test covers reality.
recommended_fix: Drop the "processing" fixture/test or rename it as a defensive check, and pin the gate's behavior with "unpaid", the value delayed methods actually produce.
